feedback: The previous iteration's robot showed improved stability and fewer line loss events on oval and s-bend tracks after increasing sensor size and widening wheel track/body width, but still failed to complete the slalom track due to off-track terminations and line loss at tape edges. The integrator had to compensate for insufficient sensor coverage at tape edges, affecting line detection and control. If the next race shows continued line loss events or off-track terminations on the slalom track, further adjust sensor positions to extend coverage beyond current edges or consider adding an additional sensor to cover blind spots. If line loss events reduce but max error or steering oscillation remain high, tune PID gains for smoother control and consider slightly reducing wheel track to improve agility. If the robot completes all tracks with low errors and minimal line loss, consider reducing sensor size to 0.012 m to improve responsiveness and reduce weight.
requested_changes: geometry.sensor_positions to extend coverage further to tape edges based on telemetry showing line loss at edges
geometry.sensor_size to 0.012 if line loss events are minimal to improve responsiveness
geometry.wheel_track to 0.15 if max error or steering oscillation remain high to improve agility
